evidence.quote: Your entire degree programme is taught in English.
If so, you’ll need to apply via uni-assist.

notes: Year of the deadline not stated; 2027 assumed. uni-assist applies if school-leaving qualifications were completed outside Germany. Tuition 'None' is page-wide (DAAD). OMITTED: intakes (no page states the year of the deadline, only day and month; verifier requires the year; expected next deadline is 15 July 2027 per DAAD 2026/2027 edition). OMITTED: tuition 0 (DAAD says Tuition fees per semester None, but no page quote with explicit wording like no tuition fees was found). RHEIN-WAAL REQUIREMENTS: official pages used: HSRW programme page, HSRW 'Guide for international applicants', DAAD 4229. The pages do not say whether the Moroccan Bac gives direct access or Studienkolleg is needed; uni-assist assesses this depending on country of the certificate and prior studies. The 'seven years of English at school' proof on the programme page applies to German school certificates; international applicants need an English certificate at B2 (accepted-test list is on a separate page and not encoded).

evidence.quote: You need an English language certificate at B2 level of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages.
English language skills B2 required, please provide an official language certificate

rules.note: Titre obtenu hors d'Allemagne : candidature via uni-assist, qui vérifie si le diplôme donne accès aux études en Allemagne.

evidence.quote: Rhine-Waal University of Applied Sciences works with uni-assist to ensure that international applications can be assessed.

rules.note: Les diplômes internationaux doivent d'abord être vérifiés avant l'admission, même si la filière est sans restriction d'accès (pas de numerus clausus).

evidence.quote: Unrestricted: enrolment is possible for nearly every German Abitur; international qualifications require verification first.
